name: wavedrom
description: Digital timing diagram in your browser
author: alex.drom@gmail.com

scripts.cli: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); fs.writeFileSync('bin/wavedrom.js', '#!/usr/bin/env node\n'); cp.execSync('browserify --node bin/cli.js >> bin/wavedrom.js'); if (process.platform !== 'win32') { fs.chmodSync('bin/wavedrom.js', 0o755); }"
scripts.prepare: npm-run-all test dist dist.min unpkg unpkg.min
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['wavedrom.js', 'coverage', '.nyc_output'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })); fs.readdirSync('.').forEach(f => { if (f.startsWith('wavedrom.') && f.endsWith('.js')) { fs.rmSync(f, { force: true }); } })"
scripts.skins: node -e "['default', 'narrow', 'dark', 'lowkey', 'narrower', 'narrowerer'].forEach(S => require('child_process').execSync('node bin/svg2js.js -i unpacked/skins/' + S + '.svg > skins/' + S + '.js'))"
